criteria.evidence: A small plush seal has a pear-like rounded body, small black stitched/button-like eyes, a short blunt muzzle and soft stubby flippers. It is a recognizable soft object, not a text label.
One palm cradles the underside while the other hand adjusts the raised flipper; the contact survives at native size.
The authored adult restorer meets the camera with a small smile. Reference bob/fringe and visible face features are recognizable. A photo cannot verify real age or identity.
A blue checkered belly patch and its surrounding stitches are clear between the supporting fingers.
The face carries the first read, then the paired hands and seal; the softer workshop shelving remains background context.

deviations: View is more frontal than the authored three-quarter camera treatment.
Toy is roughly hand-sized and slightly taller than a flat palm silhouette; exact palm-size metrology is not claimed.
